notes.title: Silent Scream 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43551443/653db98f46a2620e3355a797c129b41d88206b75.png[/img]
Hello Community,

Hope you're well. It's exciting for you to know that in this patch 1.0.5, we've added controller support for steam. Moreover, we've also fixed some bugs
and improved some quality of life features.

[b]Input:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Controller Support (XBOX, Dualshock Controllers(USB))
[*] Fixed a bug about input rebinding issues
[/list]
[b]System:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where cloud data won't loading after deleting save file from locally
[/list]
[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added gamepad rebinding options for the controller support
[*] Fixed a bug where applying for package didn't work on keyboard
[*] Fixed UI overlap issues on different monitor resolution
[/list]

notes.title: Silent Scream 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43551443/b65630dbb3eee47381f5f0cd15fbdc73b3f5a4d2.png[/img]


Hello community,

Once again, we'd like to thank you all for your continued support. Changes and bug fixes in this patch are listed below.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where player got stuck in flashback.
[*] Fixed an issue where incorrect number of police were spawning at the same time. 
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life [/b]
[list]
[*] Added more hints to the loading screen. 
[*] Now player life gets replenished when player sacrifice any customer.
[/list]

To show our heartfelt appreciation towards the community and people who have supported us immensely through development, we are including some special mentions in the credits section.

notes.title: Silent Scream 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43551443/54141db9d0e632e2835172aad5bfd62034a26444.png[/img]


Hello community,

Thank you for purchasing Silent Scream. We have just added a few changes and improvements which are listed below:

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where player got stuck whenever they tried to leave the play area.
[*] Fixed an issue with the tutorial that prevented the player from completing the tutorial. 
[*] Fixed an issue where continuing from the main menu caused the game to not load. 
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes the cutscenes would not play out as intended. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the objectives would not be displayed properly. 
[*] Improved animations. 
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life [/b]
[list]
[*] Added money remaining UI on the bottom corner of the notebook.
[*] Added hints to the loading screen.
[*] Adjusted the UI of load game menu. 
[/list]

notes.title: DEV DIARIES #2
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Everyone,[/b]

We have added one more item to the Gatekeeper's shop. [b]Shoggoth's Creation[/b].
[i]A mysterious large object made by a Shoggoth that manipulates matter creates an illusion. People inside can't see outside & people outside can't see inside.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43551443/d1a5b9601535893b2b438f02c1d07e17a979200a.png[/img]
This item is a must-have for a Restaurant Worker/Cultist.

We have also improved some of our cutscenes to give them a more cinematic feel. Looking forward to showing this all in the demo.

Until next time!

notes.title: DEV DIARIES #1
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

We are hard at work to get the demo out so you folks can try it out. We have to add a few more items to The Gatekeeper's shop, implement a few mechanics, and squash some bugs.

We have added Yellow King's Clock Fabric which will help you to hide the bodies in plain sight.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43551443/1fbe945a2c39d486552d31e29d4adb28112cec6a.png[/img]

We now need to add Shoggoth's Creation so that you can commit the crime in plain sight.
Please look forward to it.

This is our first commercial game, we are working with a tight budget and a small team. We want to bring more unique games like this in the future. If this game succeeds we will have a bigger budget to make even crazier games.
I have already finished writing the design document for a [b]Metal Gear world-inspired Combat Medic[/b] game. Would love to work on that next.

So please tell your friends and family to [b]wishlist[/b] it. We are also looking for a publisher. So if any publisher is reading this, we would love to have a chat.

Until next time!
